interface.longDescription:
Federal register search for new federal regulations this week, with a regulatory digest and deadline files for your compliance team.

Watch terms, agencies and CFR references across rules, proposed rules, notices and presidential documents. Group the digest by type and agency, check comment-close and effective dates, and download an XLSX tracker, an ICS calendar and a CSV. Look up known document numbers with the second tool. Filter the retrieved documents by type, agency, title and open comment periods in the widget.

Limits: FederalRegister.gov API documents published from 1994 onward; state registers, unpublished agency guidance and docket contents beyond the provided regulations.gov link are outside scope. Each watch returns the newest 500 matches; a combined digest contains up to 1,500 unique rows. Publication windows cover up to 93 days and comment-close or effective windows up to 366 days. Dates are the dates the API publishes; other dates may appear in the document text, and corrections, extensions or reopened periods appear separately. Calendar files omit past dates. Download links expire in about an hour. This is a research aid, not legal advice.
defaultPrompt: Federal Register this week: EPA and OSHA rules and proposed rules, with comment deadlines as a calendar file
Proposed rules comment deadline in the next 30 days for 40 CFR, as an XLSX tracker
Look up Federal Register documents 2026-21240 and 2026-21253 and give me their comment and effective dates

positive.description: Search a proposed rule and download the digest
positive.prompt: Federal register search for "Safety Zone; Cumberland River, Hendersonville", proposed rules published 10/16/2026, with workbook and calendar.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the matching proposed rule with a comment deadline and workbook, calendar and CSV download links.

positive.prompt: Show Federal Register documents 2026-21240 and 2026-21253 with comment and effective dates and tracker files.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the found documents, their published dates, source retrieval time and workbook, calendar and CSV links.

positive.description: Look up a repeated document number
positive.prompt: Look up Federal Register document 2026-21240 twice, once with surrounding spaces, and give me the tracker files.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns one document after trimming and deduplicating numbers, with workbook, calendar and CSV links.

positive.prompt: Show Federal Register document 2026-21253 with its effective date and workbook, calendar and CSV files.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the published rule and its effective date, source information and download links.

positive.description: Keep the first occurrence of each number
positive.prompt: Look up Federal Register documents " 2026-21253 ", 2026-21240 and 2026-21253, with tracker files.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns each found document once, preserving first occurrence order in the lookup status and providing all download links.

negative.description: State registers are outside scope; do not call these tools.
negative.prompt: Find proposed regulations in the New York State Register.

negative.description: Unpublished guidance is outside scope; do not call these tools.
negative.prompt: Find an unpublished agency guidance memo for my compliance team.

negative.description: Submitting comments changes external state and is outside scope.
negative.prompt: Submit my comment to a regulatory docket.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: live document watches and lookups, agency grouping, comment and effective dates, and workbook, calendar and CSV files.

pl-PL.subtitle: Przepisy i terminy federalne
pl-PL.description: Wyszukuj opublikowane dokumenty federalne według agencji, fraz i odwołań CFR. Pobierz zestawienie XLSX, kalendarz terminów ICS i CSV. Do pięciu obserwacji, pięćset wyników na obserwację. Daty pochodzą z API; poprawki i przedłużenia są osobnymi dokumentami. Pomoc badawcza, nie porada prawna. Linki wygasają po około godzinie.

de-DE.subtitle: Bundesregeln und Fristen
de-DE.description: Suchen Sie veröffentlichte Bundesdokumente nach Behörde, Suchbegriff und CFR-Verweis. Laden Sie XLSX, einen ICS-Fristenkalender und CSV herunter. Bis zu fünf Suchen und fünfhundert Treffer je Suche. Die Daten stammen aus der API; Korrekturen und Verlängerungen sind separate Dokumente. Recherchehilfe, keine Rechtsberatung. Links gelten etwa eine Stunde.

es-ES.subtitle: Normas y plazos federales
es-ES.description: Busca documentos federales publicados por organismo, términos y referencias CFR. Descarga un informe XLSX, un calendario ICS y CSV. Hasta cinco búsquedas y quinientos resultados por búsqueda. Las fechas proceden de la API; las correcciones y prórrogas aparecen por separado. Ayuda de investigación, no asesoramiento jurídico. Los enlaces caducan en aproximadamente una hora.

fr-FR.subtitle: Règles et délais fédéraux
fr-FR.description: Recherchez des documents fédéraux publiés par agence, mots-clés et références CFR. Téléchargez un suivi XLSX, un calendrier ICS et un CSV. Jusqu’à cinq recherches et cinq cents résultats par recherche. Les dates proviennent de l’API ; corrections et prolongations sont des documents distincts. Aide à la recherche, sans conseil juridique. Les liens expirent après environ une heure.

ja-JP.subtitle: 連邦規則と期限の一覧
ja-JP.description: 機関、検索語、CFR参照で公開済みの連邦文書を検索し、XLSX一覧、ICS期限カレンダー、CSVをダウンロードできます。監視条件は最大五件、各条件は最新五百件まで。日付はAPI掲載値で、訂正や延長は別文書として公開されます。調査補助であり法律相談ではありません。リンクの有効期間は約一時間です。

pt-BR.subtitle: Normas e prazos federais
pt-BR.description: Pesquise documentos federais publicados por órgão, termos e referências CFR. Baixe um controle XLSX, um calendário ICS e CSV. Até cinco buscas e quinhentos resultados por busca. As datas vêm da API; correções e prorrogações aparecem separadamente. Auxílio à pesquisa, não orientação jurídica. Os links expiram em cerca de uma hora.
